prompt:
Create one completely TEXT-FREE 1x2 runtime contact sheet with exactly TWO portrait 4:5 cells: LEFT=S01 and RIGHT=S02.
Do not add any third/fourth panel, future scene, title area, blank placeholder panel, speech bubble, thought bubble, caption box, Korean/English text, letter, numeral, UI text, logo, watermark, heart, sparkle, or emphasis symbol.
The user-approved episode visual anchor is binding for GF/BF identity, hair, outfit, palette, and approved rendering treatment. Do not redesign those anchored attributes.
Use PRIMARY_STYLE references only for drawing-language support; do not copy their cast or room.
GF_E002: adult Korean woman matching the approved anchor, dark-brown hair in a loose low bun with soft face-framing strands, cream/off-white relaxed top, pale-blue wide-leg pants.
BF_E002: adult Korean man matching the approved anchor, soft rounded black wavy hair, black crewneck top, light-gray relaxed pants.
Drawing language: simple hand-drawn black outline, minimally detailed eyes/faces, flat local color, restrained or near-zero modeled shading, low detail budget. Avoid glossy generic anime/webtoon beautification.
LEFT S01: eye-level medium two-shot. GF casually leaves the same stained DRY blue jeans beside a simple laundry basket while BF calmly accepts the request. Background is only a doorway outline plus laundry basket. GF face is relaxed and ordinary.
RIGHT S02: BF alone, 3/4 over-shoulder medium-close. One hand holds the SAME stained DRY jeans; the other hand holds a phone. Exactly two hand roles. No self-touch, no third hand. BF looks serious/cautious. The character sees the phone front; the viewer sees ONLY the phone BACK or oblique edge, never the screen/front. Background is NONE.
Preserve BF identity across both cells and the exact same jeans/stain state.
Return exactly one 1x2 art-only runtime sheet.
